questions.questionHtml:
Q7. Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A) India lost its first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS), Gen Bipin Rawat, in a helicopter crash near Coonoor in Tamil Nadu on Wednesday. A tri-services inquiry has been initiated to ascertain the cause(s) of the accident involving Mi17V5, an advanced military transport chopper.
B) Equipped with an on-board weather radar and the latest generation of night vision devices, the chopper was reportedly flying at a low altitude in foggy conditions when it crashed in a valley, leading to the death of 13 persons.
C) Even as the incident is being probed, the rescue operation has also become a focus of attention.

questions.solution:
A: This sentence introduces the main event that the paragraph is centered around - the crash of a military helicopter and the death of Gen Bipin Rawat, the Chief of Defence Staff. It sets the context and is a clear starting point.
B: This sentence provides additional detail about the event. It explains some of the characteristics of the helicopter and the conditions it was operating under when the crash occurred. This naturally follows the first sentence as it expands upon the situation initially described.
C: This sentence transitions the narrative from the event itself to the aftermath and the ongoing efforts to investigate and deal with the situation. This is a logical next step in the progression of events after the initial description of the incident.
D: This final sentence provides even more specific detail about the aftermath of the event, focusing on the fate of Gen Rawat after the crash. It offers an eyewitness account, adding a human perspective to the story and rounding out the paragraph.
